items.title: "I feel like I haven't done anything this year"
items.creator: @lyssokada
items.body: it opens with that line, then flashes one photo per month, january to december, and you realize you did SO much. it's especially hitting for moms. very emotional end-of-year scroll.

items.title: "you paid me no mind"
items.creator: @milliegarrett44
items.body: people lip-sync a super dramatic reaction to being ignored. it comes from a Dancing with the Stars meme. the sound is at 241K+ videos.

items.title: same spot, years apart
items.creator: @shavinnnnn
items.body: people recreate an old photo in the exact same spot and cut between them to Pink Floyd's "Time." that sound is at 556K+ videos and still rising.

items.title: the "secret mission" thanksgiving game
items.body: everyone gets a secret task to do during dinner, like bringing up aliens in every conversation or saying "mmmm" after every bite, and you guess each other's at the end. it's all over social right now and i NEED to try this.

items.title: gen z is the LEAST into AI at work
items.body: a Seramount survey out yesterday: only 18% of gen z want to build their AI skills, vs 36% of millennials and 46% of gen x. not what i would have guessed!!

items.title: and they don't want to admit using it
items.body: just 27% of gen z feel comfortable saying they used AI for a work task, vs about half of every other generation.

items.title: "performative availability"
items.body: being reachable after hours just to look committed. 69% of workers say it hasn't actually helped their careers, and only 8% got a promotion from it. gen z feels a bit less pressure to answer after hours than millennials.
